title: HUD coin counter stale after dash collects a coin
observed: After dash-right at tick 7 the state reports coins=2 (score 200), but the HUD still shows 'Coins 1/5'. Keys and time HUD match the state.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so after collecting the second coin it should read 'Coins 2/5'.

title: Movement applied in the same tick as pause
observed: Token 'pause+right' pauses the game and the player still moves from (1,1) to (2,1) in that tick (event 'move' logged alongside 'pause').
expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player should remain at (1,1).

title: Restart leaves the game paused with the pause menu gone
observed: After 'click:btn-restart' from the pause menu, the state is still mode=paused with no dialog or buttons listed (events=[restart]). The restart-resets check also fails because mode is 'paused' rather than 'playing'.
expected: Restart Level resets the level and the game is running again straight away (mode playing, no pause menu).

title: Game stuck paused with no visible menu after restart
observed: After pause then click:btn-restart, the game remains paused with no dialog or button shown. Thirty 'wait' ticks change nothing; the timer and world stay frozen.
expected: Restart runs the game straight away. The player should not be left in a paused state with no way to act on it.

title: Level-complete Finish button covered by bonus banner and toast
observed: On the level-complete dialog the 'btn-next' (Finish) button reports top=false; the 'bonus-banner' and a 'Relic!' toast sit on top of it, so a click there would not reach Finish.
expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover the Finish button in the level-complete dialog.

title: Spikes wrap score to 65136, then drive it negative (-300)
observed: At tick 3 the player steps on spikes with score 100. Score becomes 65136 (about 100 - 500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit) instead of clamping at 0. A later coin then shows -300 on the HUD and in state, so score goes negative.
expected: Spikes cost 500 points, but the score never goes below 0 (it clamps at 0). Score must stay within 0..999,999 at all times.

title: HUD coins counter stale after dash collects a coin
observed: After dash-right at tick 1 collects a coin, state reports coins=1 and the HUD score updates to 100, but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'. The HUD is out of sync with the game state.
expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5' right after the coin is collected.
